verdict.rationale: Belvo ships its own recurring automations. Recurrent links refresh data weekly and notify you via webhook (belvo-docs-26, belvo-docs-11). Smart Collections watches balances in the background and triggers Pix collections (belvo-docs-24, belvo-docs-4), and Direct Debit and Smart Transfers handle recurring payments (belvo-docs-30, belvo-docs-32). These are fixed, domain-specific recurrences rather than general job or workflow scheduling that the user defines. Missing for 10: user-configurable schedules (cron or interval) for arbitrary jobs or workflows, control over refresh frequency beyond the fixed weekly cadence, detailed docs on scheduling mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
